tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch full detail of a single Tulimoa listing by its slug: long description, how it uses AI (ai_usage), features, use cases, integrations, pricing detail, data region and EU hosting, model source, certifications, and links. Use after search_listings when the user wants depth on a specific tool.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the category ids and labels used to classify Tulimoa listings. Call this first when you need a valid `category` value for search_listings.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: edit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: edit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_listing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
